parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$\int_0^4\left(10x^{1/2}-\frac52x^{3/2}\right)dx$ with antiderivative $\frac{20}{3}x^{3/2}-x^{5/2}$ — B1B1; one B1 for the correct integral content and one B1 for the correct antiderivative content, then ignore subsequent working for these marks.
$\left[\frac{20}{3}x^{3/2}-x^{5/2}\right]_0^4$ — M1; use the limits correctly in an integrated expression defined by at least one correct power. Minimum acceptable working is their $(\frac{160}{3}-32)$.
Area $=\frac{64}{3}=21\frac13$ or $21.3\dot3$ — A1. Condone an extraneous $\pi$ for the first three marks. Condone reversed limits for M1 and allow A1 if the resulting negative value is corrected. If M0, SC B1 for the correct final answer. If $\int_0^4(10x^{1/2}-\frac52x^{3/2})dx=21.3$ is written with no integration seen, award B1 only.
Total: 4
